title: Unit 7 Consolidation: Legal Syntactic Architecture & Normative Modality
goal: I can use the participle in *-andó/-endő* as a legal command.
I can use *jogosult*, *köteles* and *terheli* in a duty or right formula.
I can state a condition and an exception with *feltéve, hogy* and *kivéve, ha*.
